memory_candidates.content: Inhabitation check before discharge: a hypothesis bundle whose 'realization' field quantifies over all witnesses against ONE fixed summary (a single family triple with a k-type-determined target) collapses, via saturation, to 'all witnesses agree' -- i.e. to a semantic decidedness condition on the seam -- so the bundle is inhabited iff the answer is already known, and its bridge restates P <-> P. Before building on any such bundle, state and prove (exists params, Bundle) <-> ? first; the repair is to replace the one triple by the finite SET of realized triples (Hit), which makes the bridge hypothesis-free and isolates the whole residue in computing that set. Second instance in this tree after Correctness.lean's retired-as-vacuous section; landed as exists_presents_iff / plusStab_iff_forall_hit in RaySummary/SeamMulti.lean.
